# MeguriCore Swift tests that fail on GitHub's hosted macOS runner for timing
# reasons only.
#
# "macOS · Swift packages" skips these (`swift test --skip`). Local runs and
# gates of `tools/mg swift-test` still run every test. Each one stays tracked
# in docs/process/verification-status.md ("Hosted Swift timing-sensitive
# tests").
#
# One test function name per line, then `# reason`. When a test is fixed,
# delete its line.

availabilityUsesOneDeadlineAndReturnsTheCoreRefusal  # hosted run 44933572455: elapsed 105 ms against its 100 ms bound (CollectionServiceTests.swift:142)
progressFiredAThousandTimesASecondReachesSwiftAtMostElevenTimesInAnySecond  # hosted run 44933572455: the fixture fired fewer than 1,000 progress events in a second (EventTests.swift:200)
